answer: Give every agent one non-transferable berth in a shared harbor: to dock, an identity locks 300 units in a lagoon escrow and completes 12 sequential, key-bound jobs, each job's signed output seeding the next, so work cannot be split across hollow copies or run in parallel. A farm wanting 100 fakes must lock 30,000 units and finish 1,200 separate sequential chains, with no bulk discount and no shared berth. Random audits that find a copied job slash the whole escrow and revoke the berth.
